scene:
Three zones read left to right.

LEFT ZONE, a cash bridge drawn as a descending staircase of navy-outlined bars: a tall teal bar at the far left labelled EARNINGS €10M; then five ochre steps going down, each a shorter bar, labelled in order INTEREST −€4M, TAX −€1M, INVESTMENT −€2M, UNPAID INVOICES −€1M, LOAN REPAYMENT −€1.5M; ending in a small teal bar labelled LEFT €0.5M. A small teal block labelled SPARE CASH +€0.3M sits on top of it, and a bracket around both is labelled €0.8M TO COMMIT.

MIDDLE ZONE, three stacked option cards, each with one simple icon: a person with a clipboard on the card labelled SPECIALIST €75K; a small gear with a test flask on the card labelled PILOT €210K, which carries a large ochre check mark and a stamp labelled APPROVED; a large factory of gears on the card labelled FULL PROGRAM €1M, crossed with a thin navy line and labelled TOO BIG. A dashed arrow runs from the €0.8M bracket to the three cards.

RIGHT ZONE, a short horizontal timeline with three milestones joined by a line: a magnifying glass over eight small customer figures labelled DAY 90: MEASURE; a meeting table labelled DAY 100: BOARD DECIDES; a gate labelled MORE MONEY ONLY IF ≤ 50 HOURS.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: EARNINGS €10M, INTEREST −€4M, TAX −€1M, INVESTMENT −€2M, UNPAID INVOICES −€1M, LOAN REPAYMENT −€1.5M, LEFT €0.5M, SPARE CASH +€0.3M, €0.8M TO COMMIT, SPECIALIST €75K, PILOT €210K, APPROVED, FULL PROGRAM €1M, TOO BIG, DAY 90: MEASURE, DAY 100: BOARD DECIDES, MORE MONEY ONLY IF ≤ 50 HOURS. Any other text is a defect.
alt: A cash bridge steps down from €10 million of earnings through interest, tax, investment, unpaid invoices and loan repayment to €0.5 million, plus €0.3 million of spare cash gives €0.8 million to commit; of three priced options the €210,000 pilot is approved and the €1 million program is too big; a timeline shows measurement at day 90, a board decision at day 100 and a gate for more money.
caption: From earnings to the cash Larkspur can commit, the option that fits, and the evidence that decides what comes next.
